scope: same-runtime sequential opt-in independent INSERT comparison
methodology: Three sequential fresh baseline/mirror pairs at 100 offered transactions/second, four rows per table, 1,000 source transactions, one-second coalescing; grouping off, grouping on, and grouping on with journal capacity 32. Single local pair per setting; includes observer CPU, warm-cache and run-order effects; not sustained throughput, confidence intervals or production sizing.

result.scope: bounded local transaction-rate and transaction-size map

object_operations.scope: observed fixture S3 requests by object prefix; bucket-wide requests remain separate
observed fixture S3 requests by object prefix; bucket-wide requests remain separate

result.methodology: Fresh private baseline and mirror volumes per case; order alternates. One-second publication coalescing. One persistent serial application writer. Requested rate is offered load, not guaranteed achieved throughput. Each write phase targets ten seconds; publication may drain afterward for at most ninety seconds. Resource and backlog observations include observer cost and sampling delay. Cases are sequential; no competing qualification jobs. No cold-cache isolation, capacity maximum, production sizing or confidence interval is established. Failed points are retained and do not stop the remaining cases.
